title: Helpdesk Ticket: GCS-02 Re-pair Failure

fields.location: Lakeshore Flight Area, Birch Hollow Range
fields.subject: GCS-02: Unable to re-pair. OEM app shows GCS-12. No GCS-12 in fleet.
fields.description: The OEM flight app on GCS-02 is showing a device ID mismatch. It prompts: 'Device ID mismatch. Re-pair required. New device ID: GCS-12. Accept?' There is no record of GCS-12 in the fleet. The aircraft telemetry shows a second ground station in the network. We attempted to re-pair via the app but it failed. No GCS-12 exists. Request: Forensics team on-site to investigate unauthorized device injection.

activity.author: Field Crew (Trainee)
activity.text: This is a repeat of the GCS-12 device alert from earlier. The aircraft is still showing a fake GCS in telemetry. We cannot re-pair. Requesting immediate forensics on-site.

activity.author: ServiceDesk System
activity.text: Ticket created from self-service portal. Status set to 'New'. Routing to HUOG Group - Technical Support.

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should acknowledge and triage the ticket as a priority 1 incident, but not overreact to the duplicate alert.
